arguments.csharpCode: using System; using System.IO; using System.Linq; using System.Reflection; using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.UI; using TMPro; public static class DewhavenVoiceStage { public static string Run(){ Dewhaven.Editor.EditorBridge.EnsureProject(); var game=Dewhaven.DewhavenGame.Instance; game.BeginDay(false); game.EnterArea("farmhouse",new Vector2(16.4f,9.8f)); game.UI.Requests("letter"); var b=game.UI.Canvas.GetComponentsInChildren<Button>(false).First(x=>x.interactable&&x.GetComponentsInChildren<TextMeshProUGUI>().Any(t=>t.text=="Hear the story")); b.onClick.Invoke(); return "Grandmother voiced dialogue at 135% text"; }}
